meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上个人微信通道:用腾讯官方 iLink Bot API,扫码登录后机器人以你的微信号收发私聊和群聊消息,走长轮询,不需要 webhook 和付费 token。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加个人微信渠道时接管,流程包括拷入适配器、扫码登录,以及把微信消息组接到 agent group。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加上个人微信通道,扫码登录
say.note: 它会装好适配器并打印二维码让你用手机扫

say.text: 运行 wire-dm,把未接线的微信消息组接到我的 agent group
say.note: 脚本会列出未接线的消息组让你选目标 agent group

say.text: 微信登录过期了,帮我重新扫码
say.note: 删掉 auth.json 并重启后会重新出二维码

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Scan a QR code to log in; the bot then handles DMs and group chats as your WeChat account over long-polling, with no webhook or paid token.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask to add a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw: it copies in the adapter, walks you through QR login, and wires WeChat messaging groups to an agent group.

say_en.text: Add a personal WeChat channel and log in by QR code.
say_en.note: It installs the adapter and prints a QR URL to scan.

say_en.text: Run wire-dm to wire the unwired WeChat group to my agent group.
say_en.note: The script lists unwired groups and asks for a target agent group.

say_en.text: My WeChat session expired - help me scan again.
say_en.note: Delete auth.json, restart, and a new QR code appears.
